phases.title: Port Eros Companion Console page
phases.description:
Goal: Port the single-page "Eros Companion Console" terminal-overlay UI from /imported-source into the sandbox as a working page at /frontend/pages/ErosConsole.tsx, wired as the app's route, with its fixed warm cream/rose visual theme and Google Fonts preserved.

Source → target mapping rows:
| source path | target path | class | transform notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| /imported-source/src/app/App.tsx | /frontend/pages/ErosConsole.tsx | B | - Copy the file verbatim first, then edit: no import changes needed — `react`, `lucide-react`, and `motion/react` all resolve as-is in the sandbox (the `motion` package was already added to /frontend/package.json). - Rename the default export's containing file per sandbox convention (default export stays `export default function App()` → keep function body identical, only the export name/identity via file path matters, component name may stay `App` or be renamed `ErosConsole`, either is fine as long as it's the default export). - No other structural changes: this file is fully self-contained (no ./components/ui or ./components/figma imports exist in it). - Do not import React explicitly (JSX transform is automatic) — source file already avoids `import React from 'react'` for the default import so no change needed there. |

CUT (do not port — confirmed unused boilerplate never imported by App.tsx or any other in-scope file):
- /imported-source/src/app/components/ui/** (49 shadcn primitive files — sandbox already has its own equivalents at /frontend/lib/shadcn/ if ever needed)
- /imported-source/src/app/components/figma/ImageWithFallback.tsx
- /imported-source/src/styles/tailwind.css (Tailwind v4 syntax, not applicable — sandbox has its own Tailwind v3 config)
- /imported-source/src/styles/globals.css (empty file)

New file to author (Class C — no direct source counterpart, but content is translated from /imported-source/src/styles/fonts.css + theme.css):
- /frontend/pages/erosConsole.css — a page-scoped CSS file (imported only by ErosConsole.tsx) containing:
  1. The Google Fonts `@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;1,300;1,400&family=Figtree:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap");` verbatim (CSP allows fonts.googleapis.com/fonts.gstatic.com).
  2. A `.eros-console-root` scoping class (applied to the page's outermost div) that sets the fixed palette as plain CSS custom properties AND overrides the shadcn `--background`/`--foreground` tokens locally so the one `bg-background` Tailwind class in the source JSX renders the correct cream color, e.g.:
     ```css
     .eros-console-root {
       --background: #fdf6ee;
       --foreground: #2c1a0e;
     }
     ```
     (Source theme.css defines :root and .dark identically — this is an intentionally fixed, non-dark-adapting skin. Scope the override to this page's root element only, do NOT touch the global orgTheme.css or add a global :root/.dark block, so other pages/app-shell chrome are unaffected.)
  3. Do not port the Tailwind v4 `@theme inline` plumbing or `@layer base` h1–h4/label/button/input rules — App.tsx does not rely on bare-element typography defaults; all styling in the component is inline Tailwind utility classes / arbitrary hex values.
  Import this CSS file at the top of ErosConsole.tsx: `import './erosConsole.css'`. Apply the `eros-console-root` class alongside the existing `size-full relative overflow-hidden bg-background select-none font-['Figtree']` classes on the component's outermost returned div.

Dependency delta:
- motion@12.23.24 already added to /frontend/package.json (Phase 0 completed before this plan was submitted) — no action needed, just confirm `import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "motion/react"` resolves without error.
- All other source package.json dependencies are skip (see rationale: they only backed the unused, cut ui/ boilerplate).

Routing wiring (App.tsx, sandbox's root router file — must be written LAST after ErosConsole.tsx and erosConsole.css exist):
- Rewrite /frontend/App.tsx to render the ported page as the app's single route: import ErosConsole from './pages/ErosConsole' and set up `<Routes><Route path="/" element={<ErosConsole />} /></Routes>` (wrap in BrowserRouter is already handled by read-only /frontend/index.tsx — do not add another Router). Remove the old starter scaffold (StarterCanvas usage) — delete /frontend/components/StarterCanvas.tsx related import from App.tsx (leave the StarterCanvas component file itself alone if it exists; just stop importing/rendering it). No navigation chrome/nav bar is needed since this is a single full-screen page — do not add a <nav> wrapper, since the source app is a full-viewport overlay experience.

Row ordering: author /frontend/pages/erosConsole.css first, then /frontend/pages/ErosConsole.tsx (copy App.tsx content, add the CSS import and eros-console-root class), then rewrite /frontend/App.tsx last.

Tool selection rule: Class B row → copy /imported-source/src/app/App.tsx to /frontend/pages/ErosConsole.tsx first (copy_file), then edit_file to add the CSS import and the `eros-console-root` class per the transform notes above. Class C (erosConsole.css) → write_file. /frontend/App.tsx rewrite → write_file (it's a sandbox system-convention file, not a 1:1 source port).

Carve-out: Do not create, modify, or delete any file whose target path is not listed above (i.e. only /frontend/pages/erosConsole.css, /frontend/pages/ErosConsole.tsx, and /frontend/App.tsx are touched in this phase). Do not port any file under /imported-source/src/app/components/.

Verification: after writing all three files, confirm no TypeScript/build errors are reported for these files (check especially that `motion/react` and `lucide-react` imports resolve, and that the page renders both the bar-mode floating console and (on toggling) the window-mode expanded console without console errors).
phases.notes: ErosConsole.tsx ported and compiles clean; fixed one strict-TS noUncheckedIndexedAccess issue on cmdHistory[next] access. App.tsx now routes "/" to ErosConsole with no nav chrome.

phases.title: Review the imported app for gaps and queue fix phases
phases.description:
Review the completed target app against the imported source under
/imported-source/. Identify import gaps, but do not fix them inline in this
phase.

Compare the source and target coverage for:
- routes & pages
- components
- backend functions
- serverless / edge / custom server routes
- dependencies
- styling & theming
- auth / env / assumptions

Additionally:
- run the project's build/typecheck to check for any remaining errors
- check the /plans/import-build-plan.json for any remaining deferred gaps that did not get addressed in later phases

For material gaps / build errors, append focused fix phase(s) with
`extend_phased_build_plan`. Each appended phase should be self-contained and small
enough for one context window.

Keep any comparison notes private or in tool arguments only; do not narrate the full
audit to the user. Do not re-queue gaps already covered by existing phases.

When all identified gaps have been queued, call `complete_build_phase`. If no gaps
are found, call `complete_build_phase` without appending phases.
phases.notes: Audited: ErosConsole.tsx is a faithful line-for-line port of source App.tsx (656 vs 655 lines, diff = the added CSS import). eros-console-root class + bg-background token override confirmed applied to the outer div; fixed cream/rose skin matches source theme.css (:root and .dark are identical there, so no dark-mode regression). Google Fonts import present in erosConsole.css. App.tsx routes "/" only, no nav chrome, matches single-page source. Cut list (ui/, figma/, tailwind.css, globals.css) confirmed genuinely unused by App.tsx. No backend/services/dependencies needed or missing. No build tool available to literally invoke tsc, but manual review of state/effects/handlers found no strict-TS violations beyond the one already fixed in phase-1 notes (cmdHistory index access, now null-coalesced). No gaps found; no phases appended.
